questions.q: Why is the Stevenson screen painted white?
options: To make it easy to see
To reflect sunlight so it does not heat up
To absorb heat for the thermometers
questions.why: White reflects the sun's rays so the screen stays at air temperature.

questions.q: Which best explains the very low rainfall of hot deserts?
questions.why: Subtropical high pressure: sinking, warming air prevents cloud forming.

questions.q: Describe the temperature and rainfall of an equatorial climate.
questions.model: Hot all year at about 26–28 °C with a tiny annual range of 1–3 °C. Rainfall is over 2000 mm, falling in every month, mainly as afternoon convectional storms.
points: temperature 26–28 °C with very small range (with figures)
rainfall over 2000 mm, in all months / convectional afternoon rain
